aiClouds.scenarioHint: Generates on Scenario’s servers. Nothing to install.

localFields.seedHelp: The same number gives the same image back. Leave it empty to vary.
localFields.temperatureHelp: Low, the model plays safe. High, it takes more chances.
localFields.stepsHelp: More steps refine the image and lengthen the computation.
localFields.framesHelp: How many frames the produced sequence holds.
localFields.secondsHelp: How long the produced sound runs, in seconds.
localFields.imageHelp: Leave it empty to draw from the description alone.
localFields.maskHelp: The painted areas of the mask are the ones the model redoes.
localFields.strengthHelp: Without effect when no starting image is given.
localFields.videoHelp: Leave it empty to compose the sequence from the description alone.
localFields.audioHelp: A 16-bit WAV. Leave it empty to compose from the description alone.

aiModels.empty: No employment has a provider to offer on this machine.
aiModels.appliesNow: A choice made here applies at once — Cancel does not take it back.
aiModels.automaticHint: The studio takes the best provider available, local first.
aiModels.notInstalledYet: Install it before it can serve this employment.
aiModels.installHint: Downloads {{size}} of weights onto this machine
aiModels.cancelInstallHint: Stops the download. What already arrived is kept, to resume from
aiModels.removeHint: Deletes the files. The choice that names this model is kept

detail.refused: the format or the provenance of this model is not admitted
detail.runtime: the {{runtime}} runtime is not answering on this machine
detail.plugin: no engine in this studio can open this model yet

aiModels.loadHint: Holds the weights in memory so answers come back at once
aiModels.cancelLoadHint: Stops the load and gives back the memory already taken
aiModels.unloadHint: Gives the memory back. The model stays installed on disk
aiModels.loadFailed: The load stopped. The journal says why.
aiModels.forgetHint: Removes the entry from the list. Your file stays where it is
aiModels.ownModelHelp: A GGUF weights file already on this machine. The studio does not know its licence.
aiModels.ownModelUnreadable: This file is not a GGUF the studio can read.
